name: Exa Web Search
description: Official hosted Exa MCP server: web search and page fetch. Only web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa are exposed by default; Exa Agent (agent_run) and the advanced search tool stay off, so nothing runs a multi-step research job or a paid agent call on its own.
auth: Keyless by default: https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp answers search and fetch at Exa's free rate limit, with no credential. For a paid plan or for agent_run, either add the header {"x-api-key": "{env:EXA_API_KEY}"} with EXA_API_KEY exported, or use Exa's OAuth flow (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp?login) in a client that supports it. Core stores the reference only, never the value.
cost: External paid service. Keyless search/fetch is rate limited and free; an API key or OAuth makes calls billable to the Exa account (agent_run is usage-based and is not exposed by default).
requires: Network access to mcp.exa.ai. No local binary.
verified: 2026-11-01 against docs.exa.ai/reference/exa-mcp: endpoint https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp, keyless/OAuth/x-api-key auth forms, default tools web_search_exa + web_fetch_exa, `tools` URL parameter replaces the defaults. Live handshake NOT_RUN: it needs network egress and would spend Exa credits.
limitations: No live handshake was performed; the tool names are the documented defaults, not a listing Core observed.
Search result count is controlled by the tool's own numResults argument; Core bounds the response by maxResultBytes only.
